high_level_description: This image depicts a large, ancient temple structure during a rainy day. The temple is characterized by its intricate architecture, featuring multiple levels of steps leading up to the main entrance. The structure has a prominent dome at the top, adorned with detailed carvings and statues. The walls of the temple are made of stone, showcasing elaborate patterns and designs. In front of the temple, there are several people holding umbrellas, indicating that it is raining. Some individuals are standing near the base of the steps, while others are closer to the entrance.
